summary: Mathematically identical refactor (sqrt(tk/pk)*sqrt(tk/qk) == tk/sqrt(pk*qk) for tk>0) that computes float divisions before the sqrt, avoiding the int overflow in pk*qk. Correct, minimal, and resolves the reported RuntimeWarning/nan.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why the algebraically-equivalent split form is used (overflow avoidance); a one-line note would aid future readers, but not required by repo convention.
